entries.details: Received PCR message at 23:42 hrs regarding dead body at B-142 Sector 23 Dwarka. Reached spot at 23:55. Found victim Meena Devi Sharma lying in pool of blood in living room. Complainant Rekha Sharma (daughter) present, extremely distressed. Body examined - visible stab wounds on neck and chest. Multiple blood stains throughout the room. Window sill in back wall had forced entry marks. Based on preliminary scene examination and witness inputs, registered FIR No. 912/2024 under Section 103(1) BNS. Called forensic team for evidence collection. Recorded initial statement of daughter and neighbour Ramesh Chand. Body sent to Safdarjung Hospital Mortuary for postmortem. Compiled spot panchnama with panch witnesses. Collected blood samples, fingerprints (18 sheets), footwear casts, clothing, and mobile phone.
entries.exhibits_collected: Blood samples, fingerprints, footwear casts, victim's clothing, mobile phone, CCTV from 3 sources, photographs (45 frames)

entries.details: Received CCTV footage from Ramesh Chand's house back camera. Clear footage of accused Sanjay Sharma (brother-in-law of deceased) entering through back window at 21:15 and exiting at 22:00. Received footage from park camera showing accused parking car and walking. Received footage from MCD camera showing white Maruti Swift DL3CCW1234 - ownership traced to Arun Sharma, cousin of accused. Verified from RTO and insurance records. Identified accused as Sanjay Sharma. Reviewed property dispute motive - interviewed victim's daughter and maid who confirmed long-standing property dispute over Sonipat property. Mobile phone data extracted from victim's phone showing last messages to accused demanding her to stop harassing for property.

Dispatched police team to arrest accused - teams sent to his residence in Sector 24, family members' houses, and cousin Arun Sharma's house in Gurugram. Accused not found at residence but his wife Priya Sharma was questioned. She informed that accused had left home at 20:50 on 5th December in Arun's car and returned only at 03:00 on 6th December, then left again at 05:00 stating urgent work. Vehicle DL3CCW1234 (Swift) located abandoned at Kherki Daula Toll Plaza parking. Vehicle sent to PS yard for forensic examination. Informed Highway Patrol and bordering states to be on lookout.

Received information about accused traveling towards Delhi-Jaipur route. Intercepted at Kherki Daula Toll Plaza at 06:00 hrs. Accused identified and arrested. Personal search recovered mobile phone, wallet with cash, duplicate keys of victim's house, and bus ticket to Jaipur (indicating flight attempt). Accused medically examined at DDU Hospital (MLC/DDUH/2024/8156) - scratch marks on right forearm and cut on thumb noted, consistent with defensive struggle. Recorded memorandum statement under Section 27 Indian Evidence Act. At accused's instance, recovered kitchen knife (murder weapon) from under kitchen sink at cousin Arun Sharma's house in Sector 108 Gurugram. Recovered bloodstained clothes from accused's residence. Recorded detailed voluntary statement of accused confessing to the murder. Accused produced before Ld. Duty Magistrate, remanded to 5-day police custody.

All exhibits packed and sealed. Dispatched to FSL Rohini through SI Balraj with RC No. 789/2024. Exhibits: blood samples, bloodstained bedsheet, victim's clothing, accused's clothing, murder weapon, fingerprint sheets, footwear casts, mobile phones, DVR. Vehicle DL3CCW1234 inspected by ASI Balraj - bloodstain on passenger seat recovered. GPS data extracted from infotainment system confirming route from accused's house to crime scene to Gurugram. Recorded statements of cousin Arun Sharma - confirmed accused borrowed his car on 5th December at 20:30 saying he had urgent work in Delhi, returned at 03:00 with visible agitation. Arun noticed nothing suspicious at that time. Arun will be witness.

Visited Sonipat to obtain records of the disputed property. Property records confirm that the ancestral property at Khasra No. 456, Village Karanpur, Sonipat, Haryana was in the name of Late Suresh Sharma (elder brother of accused). After his death in 2018, it devolved to his widow Meena Devi Sharma. Accused had filed a civil suit in 2023 claiming succession rights, which was dismissed in September 2024 by the Sonipat Civil Court. Court order obtained - establishes legal motive. Accused had multiple debts - obtained bank statements showing loan defaults of ₹32 lakh from various banks and NBFCs. Contacted creditors - three NBFCs confirmed pending recovery proceedings. Financial pressure established as additional motive.

Received mobile forensics report from IT Cell. Extracted from accused's phone (OnePlus Nord CE 2): (1) Deleted WhatsApp messages with victim from October and November threatening her to 'sign the papers or face consequences', (2) Location history showing accused in Sector 23 on 5th December from 21:00-22:05, (3) Web searches for 'how long does a murder investigation take', (4) Search for 'bus to Jaipur' on 6th December morning. From victim's phone: (1) Last unanswered calls from daughter at 23:35, (2) Messages to her sister in October about accused threatening her, (3) WhatsApp screenshots of threats sent to her lawyer. These establish premeditation and motive.

Conducted scene reconstruction with forensic team and independent witness. Accused was brought to scene for reconstruction. Timeline confirmed: entry at 21:15, argument 21:20-21:44, attack 21:44-21:47, victim's death 21:50, accused exits 21:58-22:00. Reconstruction matches CCTV footage, witness statements, and postmortem findings. Reviewed all evidence with IO team. Verified no contradictions in any evidence. Reviewed property documents, financial records, WhatsApp chats, and all witness statements. All pointing to accused with strong motive and opportunity.

Received final FSL Report No. FSL/DL/2024/SER/9845. Conclusive findings: (1) Victim's blood (A+) on accused's clothing, (2) Accused's DNA on murder weapon handle, (3) Accused's DNA under victim's fingernails confirming physical struggle, (4) Fingerprints at scene match accused, (5) Wounds match recovered knife, (6) Vehicle traces confirm use. Report is comprehensive and conclusive.

All evidence collected, statements recorded, forensic reports received. Prima facie case established against accused Sanjay Sharma under Section 103(1) BNS - Murder, and connected sections. Prepared final investigation report recommending filing of chargesheet before the Hon'ble Sessions Court (as murder is triable by Sessions). Compiled annexures list of 22 documents. Submitted to ACP Dwarka for approval. IO opinion - complete chain of evidence against accused. Recommended chargesheet before Sessions Court.

case_diary.case_diary_certification: Certified that this case diary contains a true and complete account of investigation conducted in case FIR No. 912/2024 PS Dwarka Sector 23.
case_diary.supervisory_remarks: Investigation thorough. Chargesheet approved for filing before Sessions Court. - ACP Dwarka, 18-01-2025
